title: Design System: Chester Luke A. Maligaso — Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero name and top-of-page statements. Ceiling 4.5rem; the page states, it does not shout.

headline.purpose: Section titles like About Me, Projects.

title.purpose: Card titles, project names, sub-section headings.

body.purpose: Reading copy, capped 65-75ch, Pencil Gray minimum.

label.purpose: Tracked small metadata, tags, chips. Uppercase only for <=4 words.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The only resting shadow. Floating UI only: dialog, dropdown, popover, toast, chat panel.

shadows.name: hairline-inset
shadows.purpose: 1px top highlight on the nav pill / elevated bars; a physical edge without a drop shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and entrances. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and button state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-contrast call to action in a view (View work, Send message).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(0.922 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.78 0.145 75 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action (Download CV). Hairline border, transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.269 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.78 0.145 75 / 0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat raised surface. Slate Panel, hairline border, no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Backend Development

components.name: Input
components.description: Transparent field with field-line border; amber focus ring, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15); border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.78 0.145 75); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.78 0.145 75 / 0.5); }

components.name: Tech Chip
components.description: Tracked-label pill for tech stack and project tags. One amber 'active' chip per group at most.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 0.10); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; } .ds-chip--active { color: oklch(0.78 0.145 75); border-color: oklch(0.78 0.145 75 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: A portfolio that reads like a well-typeset technical document. Information sits on a dark drafting surface, ordered by type hierarchy and separated by hairline rules rather than boxes, shadows, or decoration. The work is the subject; the page is the precise sheet it's printed on. The personality is precise, polished, unpretentious. There is exactly one annotation color, a warm amber, used the way a draftsman marks up a spec, sparingly, to point at the thing that matters. Everything else is graphite and chalk. This system explicitly rejects the look it is replacing: gradient text, floating blurred orbs, glassmorphism as the default surface, a blue-to-cyan gradient, and buzzword copy. Linear and Vercel are the polish references: crisp dark surfaces, tight grid, deliberate motion, depth implied by hairlines instead of frost.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, near-black graphite surface with chalk-white ink.
One amber annotation accent, used on <=10% of any screen.
Flat by default: 1px hairline borders do the separating; shadows are reserved for floating UI.
Single typeface (Poppins) carried by weight and scale contrast, with tracked small labels.
Generous vertical rhythm; content capped to a readable measure, centered in a narrow column.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Filament Amber appears on no more than ~10% of any given screen. If two things are amber, one of them is wrong. Its rarity is the entire point.

rules.name: The Grayscale-Is-A-Choice Rule
rules.body: The neutrals are chroma 0 on purpose. Do not tint them warm or cool, and never reintroduce a second hue. Color means amber, or it means an error.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (400 to 600 to 700) and scale (>=1.25 between steps), not from adding typefaces.

rules.name: The Tracked-Label Rule
rules.body: Small labels carry the spec-sheet voice: 0.08em tracking, weight 500, Pencil Gray or Filament Amber. Body and headings stay at natural or negative tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Drafting-Table Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow on a card, section, or button is a bug. Shadows answer one question only: is this element floating above the page right now?

rules.name: The No-Frost Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter: blur() is prohibited as a surface treatment. Use a solid Slate Panel with a Hairline border instead.

dos: Do keep the surface dark graphite (oklch(0.145 0 0)) with chalk-white ink and one amber accent.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Hairline borders and tonal steps, not shadows. Reserve the Overlay shadow for floating UI only.
Do earn hierarchy through Poppins weight (400/600/700) and a >=1.25 scale ratio.
Do keep Filament Amber on <=10% of any screen, for active states, focus rings, links, and key terms.
Do cap reading copy at a 65-75ch measure and keep body text at Pencil Gray or brighter.
Do use tracked, small uppercase only for <=4-word labels and chips.
Do keep motion deliberate: ease-out transitions ~150-300ms, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback on every animation.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient). Emphasis comes from weight and size, in a single solid color.
Don't ship the blue-to-cyan gradient anywhere, as text, dividers, or fills. There is no second hue.
Don't use glassmorphism / backdrop-filter: blur() as a surface. Use solid Slate Panel + Hairline.
Don't add floating blurred orbs or ambient background animation behind sections.
Don't use buzzword copy (cutting-edge, transforming ideas, elegant scalable, seamless). Name the real technology and outcome.
Don't drift into brutalism: no raw exposed structure, crude layout, or monospace-everything as an aesthetic.
Don't put a shadow on a card, section, or button at rest. If it isn't floating, it's flat.
Don't use text dimmer than Pencil Gray (oklch(0.708 0 0)) for body copy; the old text-gray-500 lines fail AA.
Don't nest cards, or repeat identical icon-heading-text card grids as a layout reflex.
